context.body: Numbers places the explicit non-entry sentence for Moses and Aaron at Meribah.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: At a later water crisis the people contend, Moses and Aaron fall before the LORD, and Moses strikes the rock after being told to speak to it.
observations.label: Moses and Aaron are denied entry at Meribah: action

observations.body: Water comes out, but the LORD says Moses and Aaron did not believe or sanctify him and will not bring the assembly into the land.
observations.label: Moses and Aaron are denied entry at Meribah: response

observations.body: speak to the rock · struck twice · did not believe · did not sanctify · not bring assembly
observations.label: Words in Numbers 20:1–13

payload.posture: Read Numbers 20:1–13 as presumption and later retelling evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: This stated cause stands beside Deuteronomy’s placement of Moses’ exclusion within the earlier Kadesh retelling.
payload.title: Moses and Aaron are denied entry at Meribah
